name: Hanayome Shuryou ~Zettai Kairaku no Hakudaku Indoku~
original_name: 花嫁狩凌 ～絶対快楽の白濁淫毒～
source:
The protagonist is the heir to a prestigious family with a 1,000-year history. Despite being a boy, he is given special treatment at the family's prestigious boarding school for girls. Perhaps due to the influence of the imperial studies he was taught from a young age, he has a strong desire to dominate and possess, and a sexual preference for fellatio, which satisfies this desire. 

He also has a unique constitution, in which his semen has an aphrodisiac effect. As a side effect, he has been forced to ejaculate daily since adolescence. One day, upon the death of his father, the head of the family, he became the heir to the family. Since one of the conditions for inheriting the family estate is marriage or engagement, he is forced to quickly find a spouse. 

The protagonist immediately selects three suitable candidates from the school he attends as his bride, and using the aphrodisiac properties of his semen and the power of his family as his weapon, he takes action using all means at his disposal.

[Plot description from the [url=http://www.crossover-soft.jp/hana_story.html]the official site[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个有着1000年历史的名门望族的继承人。尽管是个男孩，他却在家族著名的女子寄宿学校受到特殊待遇。或许是受到从小所受的国学影响，他有着强烈的支配欲和占有欲，而对口交的性偏好，正好满足了这种欲望。

他还拥有独特的体质，他的精液具有催情的功效。作为副作用，他从青春期开始就被迫每天射精。有一天，一家之主的父亲去世后，他成为了家族的继承人。由于继承家业的条件之一就是结婚或订婚，他被迫迅速寻找配偶。

主角立即从自己就读的学校中挑选了三名合适的人选作为自己的新娘，并以精液的催情特性和家族的力量为武器，使用一切手段采取行动。

[剧情描述来自[url=http://www.crossover-soft.jp/hana_story.html]官方网站[/url]]
